title: Choose Undo’s visual world
question: Keep the precision-led direction, steer it, or take the familiar category standard.

options.label: Quiet Mastering Console
options.lineage: Professional audio mastering consoles and milled precision instruments
options.thesis: The buyer tunes three decisions while Undo resolves every hidden check into one evidence-backed channel.
options.viewport: One uninterrupted control surface: setup on the left, the recommended Offer as the dominant readout on the right, and all seven checks condensed into a live assurance rail.
options.risk: It can drift into dense pro-audio software if the readout hierarchy is not ruthlessly reduced.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished comparison dashboard with cards, a stepper, and a conventional checkout wizard.
canonCard.viewport: A standard header, comparison-card grid, and prominent continue button leading into sequential screens.
canonCard.risk: Immediately familiar, but it preserves the seven-step feeling the redesign is meant to remove.
